module: The single terraforming of the terrain on which the editor tools place their objects. The road and rail networks are carved together in a single pass, with a single blend (rail has priority, PRIO.RAIL). City Builder's site grade is laid on top as a second pass: lifted before the network pass and laid back after. Each Build button calls run(), each Restore calls restore().
usage:
local gp = require('editor/toolUtilities/groundPass')
gp.run({doi = 30})   -- terraform the networks with a 30 m blend
gp.restore()         -- put the original terrain back
notes: A network registers with register(id, source); source.features(out, p) adds its terraforming elements. Optional hooks: lift(), finish(), after(), records(), hasCarve().
The carving record (owner.terraBaseline) is tied to the terrain block and the level; checkOwner drops it if the block changed.
pass() refuses to work (log W 'held: the road network is still rebuilding') while the sites are busy; run() then returns 0.
Each pass is a history transaction ('Build Ground', 'Restore Ground', 'Grade Sites') and calls be:reloadCollision() if a terrain exists.
Defaults: doi 40 m, margin 10 m, falloff 2, smooth 5, roughness 0, scale 0.5, abutLen and abutShoulder taken from roadNetwork/bridges (embankLenM, abutShoulderM).

params.desc: Current settings: on, roads, rail (booleans) and doi, margin, falloff, smooth, roughness, scale, abutLen, abutShoulder.

defaults.desc: Default values of the numeric settings.

register.desc: Registers (or replaces, if the id already exists) the terraforming source of a network.

id.desc: Network id, also the key of params (e.g. 'roads', 'rail').

s.desc: Source with features(out, p) and optionally lift, finish, after, records, hasCarve.

setSites.desc: Plugs in City Builder's site grade (lift, lay, busy, record).

features.desc: Adds to out the terraforming elements of each registered network, according to the settings p (the shared ones by default). An unchecked network (p[id] == false) is ignored.

run.desc: Terraforms the networks (if Terraform is active) then lays the site grade back, in one 'Build Ground' transaction.

p.desc: Settings that replace the shared settings for this run.

laySites.desc: Grades the sites even if they were not.

holdSites.desc: Leaves the grade lifted; laySites() must be called later.

returns.desc: Number of terraforming elements applied (0 if blocked).

laySites.desc: Lays back the site grade kept lifted by the holdSites passes, on the terrain of the last pass, in one 'Grade Sites' transaction. No effect (0) if nothing is pending.

returns.desc: Result of sites.lay(), 0 if nothing or if the network is still rebuilding.

restore.desc: Puts the original terrain back under the networks and the site grade on top (transaction 'Restore Ground').

hasCarve.desc: True if a carving is stored (shared record or something the sources would have to put back).

naturalGround.desc: Returns the function height(x, y) of the terrain before all the carvings (terraform.groundBefore). Rebuilt only if the records changed; without a record it reads the live terrain.

getParams.desc: Copy of the settings, to keep in each tool's session file.

applyParams.desc: Applies saved settings: only existing keys whose type matches are taken. Ignores a non-table argument.

getRecord.desc: Returns the carving record (keep it across Lua reloads and in sessions).

setRecord.desc: Restores a carving record (must be a table with gx a table and n > 0, otherwise it is cleared). The block id is set back to nil: checkOwner attaches the record via the level.

reset.desc: New level: forgets the carving record, since the terrain is no longer the one where it was made.
